data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 潮声礼堂的第一盏灯
data.description: 礼堂地面的潮水刚退，斯卡蒂赤足跨上第一层石阶，把手中的小灯放到宽阔的台沿。白色礼服的折纹随步子移开，金丝饰片和脚链接住高窗照下的一点晨光。
data.location: 潮汐礼堂内的石阶祭台
data.action: 赤足跨上石阶，把小灯放到台沿
data.lighting: 高窗斜下冷色晨光，灯与金丝饰片带一点暖色
data.camera: 侧后全身，石阶保留前后关系
data.promptProse: Skadi steps barefoot onto a stone dais to set a small lamp on the ledge. Her white floor-length priestess gown falls in sculpted pleats beneath its layered veil. Gold filigree and a delicate ankle chain catch the cool daylight entering high above the damp floor.
data.animaCaption: Her toes settle on the first dry step as one hand steadies the lamp on the stone.
